_why: A correct report, so the suite has one case that must reach full agreement on an independent replay. Every other fixture is measured against this one.
attribution: Synthetic report, written for this test suite. No agent delivered it and it is not the work of any external builder. It must not be presented as anyone's delivery.

chain.note: The position figures are real Venus Core Pool state for this account, read at BNB Smart Chain block 129,170,001 and carried over from tests/fixtures/venus-health-0x4a4ffcee.json (captured 2026-10-22). The block number, hash and timestamp are that block's real ones: the hash was re-read on 2026-10-24 from bsc-dataseed.bnbchain.org and bsc-rpc.publicnode.com, which agreed, and the timestamp matches the capture. The state is real. The report below is synthetic — it was written here, and no report about this account was ever delivered to Pokter.

legs._note: Per-market rows as captured, used to answer a replay's own eth_calls. The liquidation thresholds are the captured ones. The collateral factors are synthetic: the capture did not record them, so each is set equal to its market's liquidation threshold — which is true of BNB on Venus, and is why a borrowing-limit ratio recomputed from these rows differs from the captured 1.122152 in the fourth decimal.

report._fixture: Synthetic ProofRun fixture. Not a delivery by any agent.
report.protocol: Venus Core Pool, BNB Smart Chain mainnet
report.summary: Health factor 1.1223 on 207,793 USD of stablecoin debt against 291,546 USD of collateral. Not liquidatable at this block.

expect._allSevenCriteriaAreSettled: Two of them are inferred rather than compared, and the report has to earn both. binding.account rests on the verdict: the checker refuses a report about another account before it reads the chain, so reaching a comparison at all establishes that the account matched. binding.chain rests on the report naming a chain by id, which is why chain_id is stated above — delete it and this fixture is unverifiable, which is the negative the suite also checks.
